findings.message: property package 'Peng-Robinson (PR)' is a substitution for Peng-Robinson with modified Huron-Vidal mixing rules (loses: the modified Huron-Vidal (excess Gibbs energy) mixing rules; classical one-fluid mixing with kij); accepted: The selection (Carlson tree) recommends PSRK or Peng-Robinson / RKS with modified Huron-Vidal mixing rules for this polar mixture at 81.5 bar(a) without interaction parameters; the DWSIM route runs none of them. methods.yml names Peng-Robinson as the executable substitute for PR-MHV2 (it loses the polar mixing rule) and RKS for PSRK and RKS-MHV2. One property package serves the whole flowsheet (simulation.yaml takes no package per unit), and the loop with its supercritical H2, CO, CO2, CH4 and N2 sets it. For the columns alone (C-201, C-202 at 110-200 kPa(a)) the same facts at 2 bar(a) recommend NRTL with interaction parameters known (UNIFAC without), so methanol-water VLE under PR with DWSIM's own kij is the known weak spot of this model, as are the methanol and water condensation in E-103 / V-101 at 75 bar and CO2 solubility in the crude. Neither package is qualified here: methods.yml benchmarks DWSIM PR for nitrogen, oxygen and argon only and DWSIM NRTL for ethanol-water bubble points at 101.3 kPa only, not methanol-water. PR is used on that basis, as in the balance script (D-006), so that the run checks the script; to be confirmed by the reviewer (D-013).
